# Shop Travel Luggage Online

## Available for Delivery or Collection on takealot.com

Shop all your travel luggage needs online or on your phone with takealot.com. With many safe and easy ways to pay, including Cash on Delivery and Credit Card, shopping online has never been this quick and easy. Get all your travel luggage delivered to your door, no matter where you are in South Africa. Prefer to collect? Simply pick your ideal Takealot Pickup Point at Checkout and collect any day of the week.

Browse a [wide range of suitcases](https://www.takealot.com/luggage-travel/suitcases-25494), [travel bags](https://www.takealot.com/luggage-travel/travel-duffels-25505), luggage bags and more for sale online. No matter your need or where you’re travelling, start your journey with takealot.com. Choose from only the [best luggage sets](https://www.takealot.com/luggage-travel/luggage-sets-25493), including 3-piece and 2-piece sets.

Just about ready to jet off? [Buy quality boarding and hand luggage](https://www.takealot.com/luggage-travel/cabin-cases-25490), as well as affordable cabin cases, backpacks, duffle bags and more. Leave the stress behind and escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life with a dream holiday.

Make it a trip to remember for the whole family. [Shop kids’ luggage](https://www.takealot.com/luggage-travel/kids-luggage-25492), including suitcases, backpacks and even baby bags wherever you are. And, with a wide range of quality luggage safety accessories all available online, you’ll be able to travel with utter peace of mind. Shop luggage covers, locks & bolts and more protection products.
